title: Cloning of standardized L0 parts into pUAP4 for Loop type IIS assembly
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcm7iu9n

steps.title: Design primers for L0 cloning
steps.instruction: Design forward and reverse primers that add, from the 5' end, three random bases, a 7‑bp SapI site, five bases forming a partial BsaI site, one random base spacer, the appropriate common syntax fusion site, and finally 18‑25 bp complementary to the target DNA part.

steps.title: PCR amplify L0 part
steps.instruction: Amplify the L0 part from source DNA (plasmid or genomic) with a high‑fidelity polymerase such as Phusion, using 10 ng template for plasmid DNA or 100 ng for genomic DNA. Cycling: 98 °C 30 s initial denaturation; 35 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, annealing at primer Tm 30 s, 72 °C extension at 15 s per kb; final extension 72 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Run agarose gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Load PCR products on a 1.5 % (w/v) agarose gel and run electrophoresis to separate fragments.

steps.title: Gel‑extract correct band
steps.instruction: Excise the band corresponding to the expected L0 size and purify using a QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit.

steps.title: Measure DNA concentrations
steps.instruction: Determine the concentrations of the purified L0 fragment and the pUAP4 vector using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Prepare DNA aliquots
steps.instruction: Dilute the L0 fragment to 15 nM and the pUAP4 acceptor vector to 7.5 nM in appropriate buffer.

steps.title: Set up SapI assembly reaction
steps.instruction: In a 0.2 mL tube, combine L0 part, pUAP4 vector, SapI enzyme, and other components as specified in the provided Table for a Type IIS assembly.

steps.title: Run assembly thermocycling program
steps.instruction: Place the reaction tube in a thermocycler and run: 26 cycles of 37 °C for 3 min then 16 °C for 4 min; followed by 50 °C for 5 min and 80 °C for 10 min to terminate and denature enzymes.

steps.title: Transform competent E. coli
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the assembly reaction to 20 µL chemically competent E. coli (1 × 10⁷ transformants/µg DNA), incubate, heat‑shock if required, then recover and spread on LB agar plates containing 25 µg/mL chloramphenicol and 40 µg/mL X‑gal for blue‑white screening.

steps.title: Incubate plates overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated cells at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Verify insert by sequencing
steps.instruction: Pick white colonies and perform Sanger sequencing using primers UAP_F (CTCGAGTGCCACCTGACGTCTAAGAAAC) and UAP_R (CGAGGAAGCCTGCATAACGCGAAGTAATC) together with any part‑specific primers to confirm the correct L0 insert.
